'''K-8PO''' was a blue-plated [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], who was receiving treatment at the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Droid Spa/Legends|spa]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

{{Droid-stub}}
==Biography==
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Date Legends">{{TCWdates|308}}</ref>, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] sent [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to buy [[Jogan fruit/Legends|jogan fruit]] for a cake that was going to be provided at a state banquet [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was organizing for senator [[Aang/Legends|Aang]]. Shortly after they purchased the jogan fruit, [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo-360]], in order to help [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] kidnap C-3PO, flew towards them and told them about a [[Droid Spa/Legends|Droid Spa]] nearby, hoping R2 would go to it and that 3PO could be captured. After the two friends argued about going to it, R2 went to the spa and C-3PO was captured shortly afterwards.<ref name="Evil Plans" />

K-8PO was present at the droid spa at that time and he was being washed shortly before R2-D2 would be, as well. After R2 was cleaned, he received a decarbonizing buff and left the spa. He saw that his friend was missing and started looking for him. Soon after, he was also captured by Cad Bane, [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|Helios 3-E]] and Todo-360. After downloading the architectural plans for the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] from his memory banks, Bane and the others wiped R2 and C-3PO's memories of the incident and brought them back near the spa. The two then returned to Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala.<ref name="Evil Plans" />

==Behind the scenes==
K-8PO's name is revealed in the Jedi Archives feature "Development of Droid Spa Scrubbers" in the Special Features of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three]].
